verdict.rationale: Devin does support connecting to repos (indexing, GitHub-based session creation, VPN access to internal git hosts) and this is described as straightforward onboarding, but there's no evidence of a literal 'one-click install' flow like a GitHub App marketplace install — setup instead involves indexing, environment configuration, AGENTS.md, and knowledge onboarding steps. Missing for 10: explicit one-click/marketplace-style install flow, independent evidence of setup simplicity, and confirmation that repo access requires no additional configuration.
